newsitem.title: USA: UOL Publishing amends IPO terms.
newsitem.headline: UOL Publishing amends IPO terms.

text.p: UOL Publishing Inc has changed the terms of its upcoming initial public offering to 1.43 million shares in a range of $13 to $15 each, according to regulatory documents.
Formerly known as University Online Inc, the Falls Church, Virginia company originally planned to offer 1.334 million shares for $14 to $16 each, according to September filings.

The offering is tentatively scheduled for late November, according to lead underwriter Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc. UOL publishes interactive, on-demand, web-based courseware for the academic and corporate education markets.
The shares are expected to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol "UOLP".
